msg: No type, format and estimated volume of the product data the device can generate.
fix: Add: 'Data types: temperature, humidity, setpoint. Format: JSON. Estimated volume: about 2 MB per day.'

msg: Does not say whether the device generates data continuously and in real time.
fix: Add: 'The device generates data continuously and streams it in real time while online.'

msg: No statement of on-device or remote storage with the intended retention period.
fix: Add: 'Stored on the device for 30 days and on our EU cloud server for 24 months.'

msg: Missing how the user accesses, retrieves or erases the data, the technical means, terms of use and quality of service.
fix: Add: 'Export or erase in the app or via the local REST API; terms of use at /terms; API availability target 99.5%.'

msg: No nature, estimated volume and collection frequency of the product data the data holder will obtain.
fix: Add: 'We receive a reading every 60 seconds (about 1.4 MB per day).'

msg: No nature and estimated volume of the related service data (app, cloud features) and how the user retrieves it.
fix: Add a 'Related service data' line: schedules, rules and app logs, about 50 KB per month, exportable as JSON.

msg: Does not say whether the data holder uses the data itself, for which purposes, and whether third parties get it.
fix: Add: 'We use the data to run the app and improve heating schedules; we do not give it to third parties unless you ask.'

msg: No identity of the data holder (trading name and geographical address).
fix: Add: 'Data holder: Example Home GmbH, Musterstrasse 1, 10115 Berlin, Germany.'

msg: No quick means of contacting the data holder (e-mail, phone or form).
No instructions on how the user can have the data shared with a third party and end that sharing.
fix: Add: 'To share your data with a third party, name them in Settings > Data sharing; tap Stop sharing to end it.'

msg: No mention of the user's right to lodge a complaint with the competent authority designated under Article 37.
fix: Add: 'You may lodge a complaint with the competent authority designated under Article 37 of the Data Act.'

msg: Does not say whether the data holder holds trade secrets in the data, or who does.
fix: Add: 'The data contains no trade secrets.' or name the trade-secret holder.

msg: No contract duration with the data holder and no arrangements for terminating it.
fix: Add: 'The service contract runs for an indefinite period; you can terminate it at any time in the app with 30 days' notice.'

unless: free of charge|no (fee|charge)|at no cost|without charge
msg: Charges the user for access to their own product data; Article 3(1) and Article 4(1) require access free of charge.
fix: Make export free of charge on every plan; keep fees for other features only.

line_all: as long as (necessary|needed|required)|indefinitely|reasonable period|no longer needed
msg: Retention is not a period; Article 3(2)(c) asks for the intended duration of retention.
fix: State a number: 'kept for 24 months, then deleted'.
Give an estimate with a unit, e.g. 'about 2 MB per day'.

msg: The export format is not machine-readable; Article 3(1) asks for a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
fix: Offer CSV or JSON export next to any PDF.
